name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_update_session_list_query
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::UpdateSessionListQueryFromControls builds the encoded six-field session-list query string from dialog controls and submits it to the WOL API.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x43cf90 verifies UpdateData(1) on g_pWestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog, CB_GETCURSEL on m_sessionModeCombo, CString::Format with %1d%4d%4d%1d%1d%1d using selected mode, query value/time, aux param, max players, and the two status flags, then SubmitEncodedQueryString through vtable offset 0x3c.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_update_session_list_query_smoke uses a real combo box, the existing UpdateData hook, and a fake SubmitEncodedQueryString slot to verify the save flag and exact encoded string.
